bull_case: Branded checkout stabilization, Venmo monetization, Braintree economics and financial services can lift FCF/share while buybacks shrink the denominator.
bear_case: If checkout relevance structurally deteriorates and transaction-margin dollars fall, low multiples can remain a value trap.
thesis: At $52.41, PayPal trades at roughly 40% of locked Base value. The market price implies little credit for modest FCF/share growth and aggressive share-count reduction. Unlike many low-multiple stocks, even the locked Bear DCF remains above current price.

evidence.claim: FY2025 owner-style FCF proxy was about $4.562B.
H1 2026 owner-style FCF proxy was about $2.093B.

counterevidence: Branded checkout competition remains intense and active-account growth is essentially flat, limiting evidence of a widening moat.
falsifiers: If transaction-margin dollars contract persistently, branded checkout resumes material share loss, or buybacks stop creating FCF/share growth, the thesis weakens.

hard_veto_flags.veto: 현재가격이 비현실적인 Bull Case 이상을 요구
hard_veto_flags.rationale: Current price is below even the locked Bear value and far below Base/Bull; no Bull+ outcome is required.

key_kpis.threshold: sustained growth despite modest revenue growth
